title: Overtime
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, empty mid-century office tower at night, flickering fluorescent green-white light, long polished corridors and brass elevator doors, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. I went up to the thirteenth floor. They were waiting for me. 🛗

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Tess's badge opened a door that wasn't there. The photo on it was decades old.
scenes.image: an open oak door at the end of a fluorescent corridor, a narrow staircase glowing beyond it

scenes.narration: She went up. The stairwell smelled like floor wax and cigarettes and cold coffee.
scenes.image: a woman climbing a narrow wooden staircase toward warm yellow light, her shadow long behind her

scenes.narration: At the top was the office from camera thirteen. Wood paneling. Green desk lamps. Thirty workers in shirtsleeves and cardigans. All standing. All facing her.
scenes.image: a 1950s office full of workers standing silently at their desks, all facing the doorway, green lamps glowing

scenes.narration: Nobody spoke. Then a man in the front row started to clap. Then another. Then all of them. Warm. Grateful. For her.
scenes.image: 1950s office workers applauding warmly in a wood-paneled office, smiling, soft yellow light

scenes.narration: A woman with silver hair took her hand. Shift change, dear. We've been waiting a very long time.
scenes.image: close-up of an older woman in a 1950s cardigan holding a younger woman's hand, warm lamplight

scenes.narration: In 1958, they told her, a guard tried to close this floor. Lock it. Wall it off. It didn't work. The floor doesn't let anyone go. It just needs someone on duty.
scenes.image: a 1950s security guard in uniform standing alone at a desk in a dim wood-paneled office

scenes.narration: One by one, the workers filed past her and down the stairs. Out into the lobby. Out into the morning. They faded in the light like breath on glass.
scenes.image: 1950s office workers walking out of a glass lobby door into bright morning light, fading as they go

scenes.narration: All but one. At the desk beside hers sat the day guard, still in uniform. He smiled. You'll get used to the hours.
scenes.image: an older security guard in uniform sitting at an old wooden desk, smiling gently, green lamp glowing

scenes.narration: Tess sat down at the empty desk by the door. Somewhere far below, the elevator chimed. Guards don't quit the Harrow Tower. They get promoted.
scenes.image: a woman security guard sitting at an old wooden desk on a quiet 1950s office floor, alone, green lamp light

scenes.narration: Tomorrow night: two siblings snowed in at their late father's cabin. Footprints lead to the door. None lead away.
scenes.image: a remote mountain cabin buried in snow at night, a single line of footprints leading to its door
